title: Aromatic Green Spanish Potato Empanada
description: Bitter, chewy, comforting Galician empanada featuring green salsa and emulsified vegan-friendly filling, often served for lunch, steam-cooked in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and onion, and chop them into small pieces.
In a large pan, saut8 the onion and garlic in olive oil over medium heat until softened.
Add the chopped potatoes, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan, and stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender.
In a separate pan, heat the flaxseed meal in 1 cup of water over low heat, stirring constantly, until it forms a smooth emulsion.
Stir the emulsified mixture into the potato mixture, and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the green salsa and lemon juice, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a bamboo steamer and steam for 10 minutes, or until heated through.
Cut the empanada into wedges and serve hot.
